title: DATE ( 1900, 1, 1 ) = 2 is TRUE: a date is compared with a number by its serial value

source.quote: Numbers and date/time values have the same rank
source.supports: a date and a number are compared as numbers

source.quote: the integer corresponds to the number of days since December 30, 1899
source.supports: a date as a number is the count of days since 1899-12-30

derivation: 1900-01-01 is 2 days after 1899-12-30, so as a number it is 2, and 2 = 2 is TRUE.
